'''Zylixx''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who fought against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], onboard a ''Defender''-class light corvette over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nomen Karr]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jaesa Willsaam]] rashly contacted the future [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], an apprentice to [[Darth Baras]] after the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] killed Master [[Yonlach]] and her parents. However, Karr discovered her plan and talked her out of it, sending [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Ulldin]] and Zylixx in her place to wait for the Sith and end the threat.

When the Sith boarded the ship, Ulldin and Zylixx stood ready. Ulldin warned the Warrior that he could not prevail against two Jedi Knights and demanded that the Sith surrender. Zylixx, however, expected the Warrior to engage them in battle, as all the Sith they had faced did. Rather than draw his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the Warrior chose to goad Zylixx into giving into his anger and lash out, forcing Ulldin's hand. The two Knights engaged the Sith in a duel, but were easily defeated. Zylixx was the first to be slain by the deadly apprentice before he was this close in giving in to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], leaving his companion Ulldin badly injured and at the Sith's mercy.

==Behind the scenes==
{{GameDS}}
Depending on the player's choices, Zylixx's fate can be decided many different ways:
*If the Wrath chooses light side dialogues, Zylixx refuses to let the Sith walk away in peace, but Ulldin is uncertain and questions whether the Sith truly means Jaesa harm. Ulldin then walks away, leaving Zylixx to face the Sith alone. After fighting, Zylixx yields after realizing the strength of the Sith. He then wonders if the Dark Side is more powerful. At this, the Sith can either kill Zylixx or spare him, leaving him to ponder his future with the Jedi.
*If the Wrath goads Zylixx into giving into his anger, he will attack and be killed while Ulldin would be injured and at the Sith's mercy.
